versions.changelog:
GA Insights 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Launch of an AI-powered Google Analytics assistant for GA4.
- Instantly answers analytics questions in plain English.
- Offers ready-made commands for key traffic, source, page, device, geo, and conversion insights.
- Simple 2-step setup—just add the service account and provide your Property ID.
- Free tier available; paid plans add more queries, properties, and API access.
- Designed for marketers, founders, small businesses, and agencies seeking fast analytics insights.
